purpose: Raw verbatim capture backing the 100-entry backfill of the 2018-2020 cohorts added 2026-09-12. Nothing in this file is paraphrased from memory: table rows are copied from the archived official FDA pages, sponsor terms are copied from openFDA responses, prices are copied from Yahoo Finance chart-API responses.

sources.fda_2018_page_live_status: https://www.fda.gov/drugs/novel-drug-approvals-fda/novel-drug-approvals-2018 returns 404 as of 2026-09-12; the Internet Archive capture above is used as the official surviving source.
sources.fda_2019_staging_file: data/staging/fda_novel_2019_full.json (Appendix A rows already captured verbatim in a prior pass)

coverage_and_gaps.rows_captured_2018: FDA table rows 59 down to 13 were read from the archived page; rows 59-24 (36 drugs) are used in this pass. Rows 23-1 are captured-but-not-yet-sponsor-verified backlog (Krintafel, Tibsovo, TPOXX, Braftovi, Mektovi, Zemdri, Epidiolex [printed 'Epidioloex' on the FDA page], Moxidectin, Olumiant, Palynziq, Doptelet).
coverage_and_gaps.rows_captured_2020: FDA table rows 50 down to 1 were read (40 new drugs after excluding the 10 already in the master list). Rows 53, 52 and 51 sit in an archive chunk boundary and were NOT captured; row 51 is Orgovyx (relugolix) from the tail of its press-release link, but its date/brand row was not read, so it is left out rather than reconstructed.
coverage_and_gaps.rows_captured_2019: 24 of the 25 missing 2019 drugs. Zulresso is excluded (see flags.zulresso).

openfda_sponsor_results_2026_09_12.method: One openFDA Drugs@FDA count query per drug: api.fda.gov/drug/drugsfda.json?search=openfda.brand_name:"<brand>"&count=sponsor_name. The returned term is recorded exactly as openFDA prints it. NOT_FOUND means openFDA has no record under that brand/generic today, so the applicant was NOT guessed.

flags.fda_page_date_typo_firdapse: FDA's archived 2018 table prints the Firdapse approval date as 11/28/2028. The row sits between Xospata (11/28/2018) and Vitrakvi (11/26/2018) and links press release 'FDA approves first treatment for Lambert-Eaton myasthenic syndrome' (Nov 2018). Recorded as 2018-11-28 with the typo flagged in the row notes.
flags.fda_page_typos_other: 2018 page prints Gamifant's ingredient twice ('emapalumab-lzsgemapalumab-lzsg'), Oxervate as 'O [xervate]', and Epidiolex as 'Epidioloex' (row 17, outside this pass). 2020 page prints Margenza's ingredient as 'margetuximab (anti-HER2 mAb' (unbalanced parenthesis) and numbers Orladeyo's row '48' and Uplizna's row '23,' without a period. Typos were normalised only where unambiguous; the verbatim strings are preserved above.
flags.zulresso: openFDA returns NOT_FOUND for brand_name 'zulresso', generic_name 'brexanolone' and application_number 'NDA212773'. The applicant therefore cannot be machine-verified today, so Zulresso (03/19/2019) is EXCLUDED rather than attributed from memory - the same rule already applied to Pepaxto in this repository.
flags.sponsor_terms_not_found: Aemcolo, Lumoxiti, Tegsedi, Xeglyze, Pizensy, Artesunate, Gallium 68 PSMA-11, fluorodopa F 18 and gallium Ga 68 DOTATOC return no openFDA record. Each is still included because the approval itself is verified by the official FDA table, but company_name is recorded as 'applicant not machine-verifiable' and no ticker is asserted.
flags.current_holder_vs_holder_at_approval: openFDA reports the CURRENT applicant of record. For several 2018-2020 drugs that holder is not the company that received the approval (Gavreto -> RIGEL PHARMS, Zokinvy -> SENTYNL THERAPS INC, Nurtec ODT -> PFIZER, Copiktra -> SECURA, Sunosi -> AXSOME MALTA, Vyleesi -> COSETTE, Scenesse -> CLIVUNEL INC, Vitrakvi -> BAYER HEALTHCARE, Mulpleta -> VANCOCIN ITALIA, Tepezza -> HORIZON THERAPEUTICS IRELAND, Trodelvy -> IMMUNOMEDICS INC, Tazverik -> EPIZYME INC, Uplizna -> VIELA BIO, Ongentys -> AMNEAL). The original 2018-2020 approval letters were not re-read in this pass, so the issuer at the decision date is recorded as UNVERIFIED rather than guessed, and no price reaction is attributed for those rows.
flags.xenleta_sponsor_term: openFDA returns the sponsor term 'HONG KONG' for both brand_name 'xenleta' and generic_name 'lefamulin'. That term cannot be resolved to an issuer, so no company name or ticker is asserted.
flags.mulpleta_sponsor_term: openFDA returns 'VANCOCIN ITALIA' for Mulpleta (lusutrombopag), which does not match the sponsor commonly reported for the 2018 approval. Recorded verbatim and flagged; no ticker asserted.
flags.barhemsys_sponsor_term: openFDA returns 'LXO IRELAND' for Barhemsys (amisulpride). Recorded verbatim; no issuer asserted.
flags.pretomanid_attribution: openFDA generic_name 'pretomanid' returns MYLAN IRELAND LTD. A prior pass in this repository noted the sponsor as 'TB Alliance'. The openFDA term is used because it is the machine-verifiable one; the difference is flagged.
flags.prices_not_captured: Historical prices were captured only where Yahoo returned a clean, internally consistent series for a symbol that still resolves (SRPT, ARDX, EOLS, BCRX, RARE, TEVA). All other new rows carry blank price cells with an explicit reason - blank beats guessed.
